name: Base64
description: Asks the AI to answer in base64 (and encodes your message), then decodes the reply. Small AI mistakes in the base64 are repaired.

instruction.label: Instruction added to the message
instruction.default: Reply with base64 only: encode your whole answer as UTF-8 base64. No plain text, no code block, no explanation outside the base64.

strict.label: Strict (fail on any damage instead of repairing)

keepOnFail.label: Show the raw reply if decoding fails
